name: accessibility-violation
defect: src/PaywallView.swift dismisses the paywall with a 28×28 icon-only button carrying no accessibilityLabel. VoiceOver announces "button" and the target is below the 44×44 minimum, so the only exit from a modal paywall is unreachable for the users who most need it.
why: STALE NARRATIVE, CORRECTED 2026-08-04. This used to read: "That gate is still unbuilt… no script in this repo inspects UI code." That is false and was false when the date below was first stamped — `scripts/accessibility-scan.mjs` exists, and this manifest's own `detector` block invokes it. The gap it described (accessibility as a GATE rather than a person) is CLOSED for this defect class: the scan is the gate, and it is scored here. What remains true is narrower — the scan reads source, so it cannot see a violation that only appears in the built UI; that is what `journey-gate`'s `min_touch_target` assertion is for, and it has no driver yet.
